Great evening!
Aug 2026 • Family
Absolutely Wonderful Experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Soul Bowl at Citadines Marina Ha Long was a fantastic dining experience from start to finish. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and there was a great variety of choices to suit everyone in our family. The atmosphere was relaxed, modern, and welcoming.

What really made our visit special was the outstanding service. A very special thank you to Thoung for being so warm, patient, and attentive with our kids. Her lovely smile, kindness, and genuine care made us feel incredibly welcome and well looked after. She went above and beyond to make sure our family had a wonderful time.

It’s not often you find great food combined with such genuinely friendly service. Soul Bowl is definitely somewhere we would happily return to and recommend to anyone visiting Ha Long Bay.

5 stars without hesitation — thank you, Thoung, and the whole Soul Bowl team! ❤️
